bundle.shortDescription: Search the verses of five Sanskrit works on plant science, with current plant names, pictures and recitations
bundle.longDescription: Version 2 (2026): one search over 869 verses, 235 plants and 428 Sanskrit plant names; current plant names with the 2011 names kept; verse pages with recitation; plant pages with distribution map, synonyms and pictures; subject and keyword browsing. Works offline.
